params.prompt: A realistic screenshot of a Google Maps mobile app in dark mode, top-down map view of a dense residential city block with streets, buildings and small park. Exactly five business pins with labels in Russian: «Кофейня», «Салон красоты», «Стоматология», «СТО», «Магазин». Each pin has a small category icon (coffee cup, scissors, tooth, wrench, shopping bag) and a blue-white pin marker; the labels are crisp, legible, clean sans-serif. A subtle location circle around the user's blue dot in the center. Authentic Google Maps UI style: dark map tiles, muted street names, rounded search bar at top left empty, zoom controls. No other pins, no watermark, no extra text, no people. Square 1:1, high fidelity, sharp UI rendering.
